summary: Brothers Andrew (9), Alexander (7) and Tanner (5) Skelton disappeared while staying with their father in Morenci, Michigan over Thanksgiving 2010 and have never been found.

name: Megan Kanka
summary: Seven-year-old Megan Kanka was raped and murdered by a neighbor who was a twice-convicted sex offender. The family had no knowledge of his criminal history.

name: Mollie Tibbetts
summary: Twenty-year-old University of Iowa student Mollie Tibbetts vanished while jogging in Brooklyn, Iowa. Her body was found a month later in a cornfield. Cristhian Bahena Rivera was convicted of her murder in 2021.

name: Missy Bevers
summary: Fitness instructor Missy Bevers was murdered inside a church before an early morning fitness class. Security cameras captured her killer walking through the church dressed in police tactical gear, but the suspect has never been…

name: Lori Erica Ruff
summary: A Texas woman known as Lori Erica Ruff died by suicide on Christmas Eve, leaving behind evidence she had been living under a stolen identity for decades.

name: Sumter County Does
summary: A young couple was found shot to death on a rural road near Sumter, South Carolina. They remained unidentified for 45 years until DNA genealogy identified them in 2021 as James Paul Freund and Pamela Mae Buckley, both from out…

name: William Tyrrell
summary: Three-year-old William Tyrrell vanished while playing in his foster grandmother's front yard in Kendall, New South Wales, wearing a Spider-Man costume.

name: Jack the Stripper Victims
summary: Six women, all sex workers, were found murdered in or near the Thames in west London between 1964 and 1965. The killer, dubbed 'Jack the Stripper' by the media, was never identified despite a massive police investigation led by…

name: Sofia Silva, Kristin Lisk & Kati Lisk
summary: Sixteen-year-old Sofia Silva was abducted from her front porch in Spotsylvania County, Virginia, in September 1996. Eight months later, sisters Kristin (15) and Kati Lisk (12) vanished from their home; all three were found…

name: Sarah and Jacob Hoggle
summary: Two-year-old Sarah and three-year-old Jacob Hoggle were last seen with their mother, Catherine Hoggle, in Montgomery County, Maryland, in September 2014 and have never been found.

name: Debra Jan Baker
summary: Debra Jan Baker was found stabbed to death in her Cheyenne, Wyoming apartment. Her six-month-old daughter was found unharmed in a crib nearby. Despite DNA evidence from the scene, her killer has never been identified.

name: Austin Yogurt Shop Victims
summary: Four teenage girls were murdered and the I Can't Believe It's Yogurt shop was set on fire in Austin, Texas, on December 6, 1991.

name: Johnny Giordano
summary: Seven-year-old Johnny Giordano vanished from his neighborhood in Woonsocket, Rhode Island while playing outside. Despite an immediate search and investigation, he was never found.

name: Anthonette Cayedito
summary: Nine-year-old Anthonette Cayedito disappeared from her Gallup, New Mexico home after a knock at the door in the early hours of April 6, 1986. Her younger sister later said she saw two men take her.

name: Jaycee Dugard
summary: Eleven-year-old Jaycee Dugard was kidnapped from a bus stop in South Lake Tahoe. She was held captive for 18 years by Phillip and Nancy Garrido in their backyard compound, bearing two children. She was discovered alive in 2009.

name: Gilgo Beach Victims
summary: The remains of at least 10 people were discovered along Ocean Parkway near Gilgo Beach, Long Island, in 2010 and 2011. Rex Heuermann, a Manhattan architect arrested in July 2023, pleaded guilty in April 2026 to the murders of…

name: Nique Leili
summary: Nique Leili, 44, disappeared from her home in Lawrenceville, Georgia, in July 2011. About a week later volunteer searchers found her body under a pile of leaves near her neighborhood.

name: Darlene Hulse
summary: Darlene Hulse, a 28-year-old mother of three, was attacked by a stranger who came to the door of her home near Argos, Indiana, on the morning of August 17, 1984, while her young daughters were inside.

name: Corrie McKeague
summary: RAF gunner Corrie McKeague, 23, vanished after a night out in Bury St Edmunds, Suffolk, on September 24, 2016. CCTV showed him entering an area containing commercial waste bins, and a months-long landfill search found no remains.

name: Aniah Blanchard
summary: Nineteen-year-old Aniah Blanchard, stepdaughter of UFC fighter Walt Harris, disappeared from Auburn, Alabama, in October 2019. Her remains were found a month later in Macon County.

name: Summer Wells
summary: Five-year-old Summer Wells vanished from her family's rural home in Hawkins County, Tennessee. Her mother said she went to play in the yard and disappeared.

name: Maddie Clifton
summary: Eight-year-old Maddie Clifton was murdered by her 14-year-old neighbor Joshua Phillips, who hid her body under his waterbed for a week. When his mother discovered the body, she called police.

name: Jason Ellis
summary: Bardstown, Kentucky police officer Jason Ellis was ambushed and killed on a highway exit ramp while driving home from his shift.

name: Gabby Petito
summary: Twenty-two-year-old Gabby Petito vanished in late August 2021 during a cross-country van trip with her fiancé Brian Laundrie. Her remains were found on September 19, 2021 at the Spread Creek camping area in Wyoming; she had been…

name: Susan Cox Powell
summary: Susan Powell disappeared from her West Valley City, Utah home. Her husband Josh claimed he went camping with their sons in freezing weather that night.

name: Fort Worth Missing Trio
summary: Three young women—Rachel Trlica (17), Renee Wilson (14), and Julie Ann Moseley (9)—went Christmas shopping at a Fort Worth mall and never returned. Their car was found at the mall.

name: Cornelia Crilley
summary: Flight attendant Cornelia Crilley was found strangled in her Manhattan apartment. The case went cold for nearly 40 years until DNA matched serial killer Rodney Alcala, the 'Dating Game Killer,' who pleaded guilty in 2012.

name: Dee Dee Blanchard
summary: Dee Dee Blanchard was murdered by her daughter Gypsy Rose's boyfriend after years of medical child abuse (Munchausen syndrome by proxy). Gypsy had been forced to feign illness and disability her entire life.

name: Nipsey Hussle
summary: Grammy-nominated rapper and community activist Nipsey Hussle was shot and killed outside his Marathon Clothing store in the Hyde Park neighborhood of Los Angeles. Eric Holder Jr. was convicted of first-degree murder in 2022.

name: Daniel Morcombe
summary: Thirteen-year-old Daniel Morcombe disappeared while waiting for a bus at Woombye on Queensland's Sunshine Coast on December 7, 2003.

name: Sarah Everard
summary: Sarah Everard, 33, was kidnapped, raped and murdered by serving Metropolitan Police officer Wayne Couzens while walking home in south London on March 3, 2021.

name: Jenny Lin
summary: Fourteen-year-old Jenny Lin was murdered in her Castro Valley, California home while her parents were at work. The case remains unsolved despite DNA evidence.

name: Peter Falconio
summary: British tourist Peter Falconio was shot on the Stuart Highway near Barrow Creek in Australia's Northern Territory on July 14, 2001; his girlfriend Joanne Lees escaped.

name: Brandy Hall
summary: Firefighter Brandy Hall vanished on August 17, 2006 after leaving the Malabar fire station in Brevard County, Florida, where she volunteered.

name: Emanuela Orlandi
summary: Fifteen-year-old Emanuela Orlandi, daughter of a Vatican employee, disappeared in Rome. Her case has been linked to theories involving the Vatican, organized crime, and international espionage.

name: Jayme Closs
summary: Thirteen-year-old Jayme Closs was kidnapped after her parents were murdered in Barron, Wisconsin. She escaped 88 days later. Jake Patterson was sentenced to life in prison.

name: Trevaline Evans
summary: Antiques dealer Trevaline Evans vanished from her shop in Llangollen, Wales, leaving a 'Back in 2 minutes' sign on the door. She was never seen again.

name: Phoenix Coldon
summary: Twenty-three-year-old Phoenix Coldon left her parents' home in Spanish Lake, Missouri and vanished. Her car was found abandoned with the engine running near East St. Louis, Illinois.

name: Rachel Cooke
summary: Nineteen-year-old Rachel Cooke vanished while jogging near her parents' home in Georgetown, Texas. Despite extensive investigation, she has never been found.

name: Terrance Williams
summary: Terrance Williams disappeared after a traffic stop in Naples, Florida. Deputy Steven Calkins, who had also been the last person to see another missing man, was fired but never charged.

name: Dorothy Kilgallen
summary: Journalist Dorothy Kilgallen, who was investigating the JFK assassination, was found dead in her New York townhouse. Her death was ruled an overdose but many believe she was murdered.

name: Dagmar Hagelin
summary: Swedish-Argentine teenager Dagmar Hagelin, 17, was shot and abducted by an Argentine Navy task force in El Palomar, Buenos Aires, on January 27, 1977, apparently mistaken for someone else. She was never seen again.

name: Helen Brach
summary: Candy heiress Helen Brach vanished after a visit to the Mayo Clinic. Her disappearance was linked to a horse-related fraud ring. She was declared legally dead in 1984.

name: Malaysia Airlines Flight MH370
summary: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 disappeared with 239 people on board during a flight from Kuala Lumpur to Beijing. Despite the most expensive search in aviation history, including renewed seabed searches by Ocean Infinity in 2018…

name: Barbara Bolick
summary: Barbara Bolick, 55, of Corvallis, Montana, vanished on July 18, 2007 while hiking at Bear Creek Overlook in the Bitterroot Mountains. Her hiking companion said he looked away at the view for about a minute and she was gone.

name: Nicole Morin
summary: Eight-year-old Nicole Morin disappeared from the hallway of her Toronto apartment building while on her way to the swimming pool. She has never been found.

name: Cecilia Zhang
summary: Nine-year-old Cecilia Zhang was kidnapped from her bedroom in Toronto. Her body was found five months later. Min Chen pleaded guilty to second-degree murder.

name: Daniel Morgan
summary: Private investigator Daniel Morgan was murdered with an axe in a pub car park in Sydenham, London. Five police investigations failed to bring anyone to justice, with police corruption impeding the case.

name: Marion Barter
summary: Australian schoolteacher Marion Barter secretly changed her name before vanishing during an overseas trip. She legally became 'Florabella Natalia Marion Remakel' before disappearing.

name: Patricia Adkins
summary: Honda worker Patricia 'Patti' Adkins, 29, vanished after finishing her shift at the Marysville, Ohio plant on June 29, 2001, having told family she was leaving on a secret trip with a married coworker.

name: Angie Housman
summary: Nine-year-old Angie Housman was abducted after getting off her school bus in St. Ann, Missouri. Her body was found nine days later in a conservation area in St. Charles County.

name: Mark Kilroy
summary: University of Texas student Mark Kilroy was kidnapped during spring break in Matamoros, Mexico and ritually murdered by a drug-trafficking cult. His remains were found at a ranch with other victims.

name: Meredith Kercher
summary: British exchange student Meredith Kercher was murdered in Perugia, Italy. Rudy Guede was convicted. Amanda Knox and Raffaele Sollecito were convicted, then ultimately acquitted.

name: Deborah Waring
summary: Twenty-year-old Deborah Waring was found murdered in Goddard Memorial State Park in Warwick, Rhode Island. Her case is one of Rhode Island's oldest unsolved homicides.

name: Grimes Sisters
summary: Sisters Barbara (15) and Patricia (12) Grimes disappeared after attending a movie in Chicago. Their frozen bodies were found a month later along a rural road. The case has never been solved.

name: Scott Johnson
summary: American mathematician Scott Johnson was found dead at the base of cliffs in Manly, Sydney. Initially ruled a suicide, his death was reclassified as a gay hate crime. Scott White pleaded guilty to manslaughter in 2023.

name: Marvin 'Alvin' Smith
summary: Seventeen-year-old Alvin Smith, a Nebraska football prospect, was found dead in a hotel air shaft in Lincoln. His death was ruled accidental but his family disputes this finding.

name: Suzanne Sevakis
summary: Known for years as 'Sharon Marshall' and 'Tonya Hughes,' Suzanne Sevakis was taken as a young child in 1975 by Franklin Delano Floyd, who raised her under false names.

name: Katrice Lee
summary: Two-year-old British toddler Katrice Lee vanished from a NAAFI shop on a British military base in Paderborn, Germany, on her second birthday. She has never been found.

name: Jill Meagher
summary: Irish-born ABC radio journalist Jill Meagher was raped and murdered while walking home in Brunswick, Melbourne. Adrian Bayley, a serial rapist on parole, was sentenced to life.

name: Lynette Dawson
summary: Lynette Dawson vanished from her Sydney home. Her husband Chris Dawson, a former rugby league player and teacher, was convicted of her murder in 2022 after the podcast 'The Teacher's Pet' revived interest.

name: Nell Cropsey
summary: Nineteen-year-old Nell Cropsey vanished from her family home in Elizabeth City, North Carolina. Her body was found in the Pasquotank River 37 days later. Her beau Jim Wilcox was convicted but later pardoned.

name: Backpacker Murders Victims
summary: Seven backpackers were murdered and buried in the Belanglo State Forest south of Sydney between 1989-1992. Ivan Milat was convicted of all seven murders and sentenced to seven life terms.

name: Christopher Kerze
summary: Seventeen-year-old Christopher Kerze stayed home from school in Eagan, Minnesota on April 20, 1990, then left in the family van, leaving a note saying he would be back by 6 p.m.

name: Claudia Kirschhoch
summary: Claudia Kirschhoch, a 29-year-old New York travel writer working for Frommer's, vanished in Negril, Jamaica on May 27, 2000 after a press trip to Cuba was cancelled.

name: Barbara Blatnik
summary: Seventeen-year-old Barbara Blatnik of Garfield Heights, Ohio was found strangled beside a road in Cuyahoga Falls on December 20, 1987.

name: Robert Pickton Victims
summary: Pig farmer Robert Pickton murdered women from Vancouver's Downtown Eastside. Convicted of six counts of second-degree murder, he was suspected of killing 49 women.

name: Tina Smith
summary: Tina Smith, 41, was found beaten and strangled in her Roanoke County, Virginia home in December 2010, and her 12-year-old daughter was missing.

name: Dorothy Jane Scott
summary: Dorothy Jane Scott, 32, disappeared from the parking lot of UC Irvine Medical Center in Orange County, California on May 28, 1980 after months of calls from an unknown stalker, who went on phoning her mother afterward.

name: Amy Lord
summary: Twenty-four-year-old Amy Lord was kidnapped from her South Boston apartment, forced to withdraw money from ATMs, then murdered. Edwin Alemany was convicted and sentenced to life.

name: Vanessa Guillen
summary: Army specialist Vanessa Guillen was bludgeoned to death by fellow soldier Aaron Robinson at Fort Hood. The case exposed systemic failures in military sexual harassment reporting.

name: Ann Marie Burr
summary: Eight-year-old Ann Marie Burr vanished from her Tacoma, Washington home. Serial killer Ted Bundy, who lived nearby as a teenager, has been speculated as a suspect but the connection was never proven.

name: Gannon Stauch
summary: Eleven-year-old Gannon Stauch was reported missing from his home near Colorado Springs in January 2020, and his remains were found in Florida that March.

name: Pamela Butler
summary: Pamela Butler, a 47-year-old Environmental Protection Agency analyst, vanished from her Washington, D.C. home in February 2009. Her boyfriend Jose Rodriguez-Cruz was arrested in 2017, pleaded guilty to second-degree murder and…

name: Diane Schuler
summary: Diane Schuler drove the wrong way on the Taconic State Parkway while intoxicated, killing herself, her daughter, three nieces, and three men in another vehicle. Her family disputed the toxicology findings.

name: Lori Hacking
summary: Lori Hacking was murdered by her husband Mark after she discovered he had lied about being accepted to medical school. He disposed of her body in a dumpster.

name: Niqui McCown
summary: Marilyn "Niqui" McCown, 28, disappeared on July 22, 2001 in Richmond, Indiana, after doing laundry and stopping at a convenience store, three weeks before her wedding.

name: Karen Mitchell
summary: Sixteen-year-old Karen Mitchell vanished on November 25, 1997 after leaving the Bayshore Mall in Eureka, California on foot. Authorities believe she was abducted; she has never been found and no one has been charged.

name: Lisk Sisters
summary: Sisters Kristin (15) and Kati (12) Lisk were abducted from outside their Spotsylvania County, Virginia home on May 1, 1997; their bodies were found five days later in the South Anna River.

name: Leigh Matthews
summary: Leigh Matthews, a 21-year-old student, was kidnapped for ransom from the parking lot of Bond University's campus in Johannesburg on July 9, 2004; her body was found near Walkerville on July 21.

name: Erica Parsons
summary: Adopted teenager Erica Parsons was last seen in late 2011 at age 13 and was not reported missing until 2013. Her remains were found in South Carolina in 2016.

name: Shannan Gilbert
summary: Shannan Gilbert disappeared at Oak Beach, Long Island on May 1, 2010; the search for her led to the discovery of the Gilgo Beach victims. Her remains were found in December 2011 and her cause of death is officially undetermined.

name: Lena Chapin
summary: Lena Chapin, 20, vanished in February 2006 in Missouri. Relatives say she had told them she witnessed the 1999 killing of her stepfather, Gary McCullough, who is also still missing.

name: Sandra Cantu
summary: Eight-year-old Sandra Cantu was murdered by Melissa Huckaby, a Sunday school teacher and neighbor in Tracy, California. Huckaby pleaded guilty to murder and kidnapping.

name: Ahmaud Arbery
summary: Ahmaud Arbery was chased and shot dead while jogging in Brunswick, Georgia by three white men. The case sparked national outrage over racial violence. All three were convicted of murder.

name: Kelsey Berreth
summary: Pilot and flight instructor Kelsey Berreth was murdered on Thanksgiving Day by her fiancé Patrick Frazee in Woodland Park, Colorado. He burned her body. Frazee was sentenced to life.

name: Dylan Redwine
summary: Thirteen-year-old Dylan Redwine disappeared during a court-ordered visit with his father Mark in Bayfield, Colorado. Mark Redwine was convicted of his murder in 2021.

name: Heather Elvis
summary: Twenty-year-old Heather Elvis vanished on December 18, 2013; her car was found at Peachtree Landing in Socastee, near Myrtle Beach.

name: Alissa Turney
summary: Seventeen-year-old Alissa Turney disappeared on May 17, 2001, the last day of her junior year at Paradise Valley High School in Phoenix.

name: Brian Carrick
summary: Seventeen-year-old Brian Carrick disappeared on December 20, 2002 after going to Val's Foods, the grocery store in Johnsburg, Illinois where he worked. His body has never been found.

name: Holly Branagan
summary: Seventeen-year-old Holly Branagan was found stabbed to death in the kitchen of her family's home in Bethlehem, Pennsylvania on March 28, 1979. No one has been arrested.

name: Sierah Joughin
summary: Twenty-year-old Sierah Joughin was abducted while bicycling in rural Ohio. James Worley, a convicted kidnapper, was convicted of her murder and sentenced to death.

name: Mary Agnes Moroney
summary: Two-year-old Mary Agnes Moroney was taken from her family's Chicago home on May 15, 1930 by a woman calling herself Julia Otis, who never returned her.

name: Jason Derek Brown
summary: Jason Derek Brown is wanted by the FBI for the murder and robbery of an armored car guard outside a movie theater in Phoenix, Arizona. He is believed to have fled to international destinations.

name: Robert William Fisher
summary: Robert Fisher is wanted for killing his wife and two children and blowing up their Scottsdale home to cover the crime. He has been a fugitive since 2001.

name: Rui Pedro
summary: Eleven-year-old Rui Pedro Teixeira Mendonça disappeared from Lousada, Portugal on March 4, 1998. Afonso Dias, acquitted at a first trial in 2012, was later convicted of kidnapping and sentenced to three years in prison; he was…

name: Princess Doe (Dawn Olanick)
summary: A teenage girl found bludgeoned to death in Cedar Ridge Cemetery in Blairstown, New Jersey on July 15, 1982 was known for 40 years as "Princess Doe." In July 2022 she was identified through DNA as 17-year-old Dawn Olanick of…

name: Boy in the Box (Joseph Augustus Zarelli)
summary: A young boy's body found in a box in Philadelphia in 1957 went unidentified for 65 years. In 2022, DNA genealogy identified him as Joseph Augustus Zarelli.

name: El Dorado Jane Doe ("Kelly")
summary: A young woman who used several aliases was killed at the Whitehall Motel in El Dorado, Arkansas on July 10, 1991; her ex-boyfriend James McAlphin was convicted in her death.

name: Belle in the Boot
summary: A woman's remains were found in a sleeping bag near a freeway in Pacific Palisades, California. She was wearing expensive Western boots. Her identity remains unknown.

name: Orange Socks (Debra Jackson)
summary: A woman wearing only orange socks was found murdered in a culvert along Interstate 35 near Georgetown, Texas in 1979. Henry Lee Lucas confessed and was sentenced to death, but evidence placed him in Florida and his sentence was…

name: Cheryl Grimmer
summary: Three-year-old Cheryl Grimmer was taken from outside the shower block at Fairy Meadow Beach, Wollongong, on January 12, 1970. A man was charged in 2017, but prosecutors dropped the case in 2019 after his 1971 confession, made as…

name: Haleigh Cummings
summary: Five-year-old Haleigh Cummings vanished from her father's mobile home in Satsuma, Florida. Her father's girlfriend Misty Croslin was babysitting. No one has been charged.

name: Elsie Paroubek
summary: Five-year-old Elsie Paroubek vanished from her Chicago neighborhood in 1911. Her body was found in a drainage canal weeks later. The case inspired one of outsider artist Henry Darger's works.

name: Lacey Fletcher
summary: Lacey Fletcher, 36, was found dead on January 3, 2022 on a couch in her parents' home in Slaughter, Louisiana, after years of severe neglect.

name: Carol Stuart
summary: Charles Stuart murdered his pregnant wife Carol and blamed a Black carjacker, triggering a racist manhunt in Boston. Stuart jumped to his death when the truth emerged.

name: Kathleen Peterson
summary: Kathleen Peterson was found dead at the bottom of a staircase in her Durham, North Carolina home on December 9, 2001. Her husband Michael Peterson, who said she fell, was convicted of murder in 2003, but the verdict was set…

name: Holly Maddux
summary: Holly Maddux disappeared in Philadelphia in September 1977; her body was found in a trunk in the apartment of her former partner, counterculture figure Ira Einhorn, in 1979.

name: Kenneka Jenkins
summary: Nineteen-year-old Kenneka Jenkins was found dead in a walk-in freezer at the Crowne Plaza Chicago O'Hare hotel in Rosemont, Illinois in September 2017 after attending a party there.

name: Keddie Murders
summary: Three people were bludgeoned and stabbed in cabin 28 at the Keddie Resort in rural Northern California. A fourth victim, a 12-year-old girl, was also murdered. The case has never been solved.

name: Robert Durst Victims
summary: Real estate heir Robert Durst was tied to three deaths: the 1982 disappearance of his wife Kathie, the 2000 shooting of his friend Susan Berman in Los Angeles, and the 2001 killing of Morris Black in Galveston, of which he was…

name: Teresa Halbach (Making a Murderer)
summary: Photographer Teresa Halbach was murdered in Manitowoc County, Wisconsin. Steven Avery and his nephew Brendan Dassey were convicted. The case was featured in Netflix's 'Making a Murderer.'

name: Sarah Stern
summary: Nineteen-year-old Sarah Stern was murdered by childhood friend Liam McAtasney for inheritance money. Her body was thrown off a bridge. McAtasney was convicted after being secretly recorded confessing.

name: Tylee Ryan & JJ Vallow
summary: Siblings Tylee Ryan and JJ Vallow were murdered by their mother Lori Vallow Daybell and her husband Chad Daybell. The case involved doomsday beliefs and multiple other deaths.

name: Macin Smith
summary: Seventeen-year-old Macin Smith left his St. George, Utah home on the morning of September 1, 2015 and never arrived at school. He left behind his phone, wallet and laptop, and a note was later found in his wallet.

name: Joey Lynn Offutt
summary: Joey Lynn Offutt disappeared in July 2007 around the time a fire destroyed her home near Sykesville, Pennsylvania; the body of her six-week-old son was found in the house. Her car was later found parked in State College.

name: Madeline Kingsbury
summary: Twenty-six-year-old Madeline Kingsbury vanished on March 31, 2023, after she and Adam Fravel, the father of her two children, dropped the children at daycare in Winona, Minnesota.

name: Mary Boyle
summary: Six-year-old Mary Boyle vanished on March 18, 1977, near her grandparents' home at Cashelard, County Donegal, Ireland, after following her uncle part of the way as he returned a ladder to a neighbour.

name: Anne Marie Fahey
summary: Delaware Governor's scheduling secretary Anne Marie Fahey was murdered by her lover Thomas Capano, a prominent attorney. He disposed of her body at sea. Capano was sentenced to death.

name: Lisa Ziegert
summary: Teacher's aide Lisa Ziegert was abducted from Brittany's Card and Gift Shoppe in Agawam, Massachusetts, on April 15, 1992, and found murdered four days later.

name: Sophie Sergie
summary: Sophie Sergie, 20, was found murdered in a bathtub in a University of Alaska Fairbanks dormitory in April 1993. Genetic genealogy led to the 2019 arrest of former student Steven Downs, who was convicted in 2022 and sentenced to…

name: Wayne Nance Victims
summary: Wayne Nance is suspected of murdering at least six people in western Montana between 1974 and 1985. He was shot dead in September 1986 by Doug Wells, his manager at a Missoula furniture store, after attacking Wells and his wife…

name: Jessica Dishon
summary: Seventeen-year-old Jessica Dishon disappeared from her family's driveway in Shepherdsville, Kentucky, in 1999 and was found dead days later. A neighbor was charged but released after a mistrial and dismissal of the charges.

name: Lisa Stebic
summary: Lisa Stebic vanished from her Plainfield, Illinois home during a contentious divorce. Her husband Craig refused to cooperate with police. She has never been found.

name: Patrick Warren Sr.
summary: Patrick Warren Sr., 52, was shot and killed by a Killeen, Texas, police officer responding to a mental health call on January 10, 2021.

name: Charles Morgan
summary: Escrow company president Charles Morgan was found shot dead in the desert near Tucson wearing a bulletproof vest and with a map to a motel. He had reported being stalked and had painted his car to avoid detection.

name: Jennifer Servo
summary: TV reporter Jennifer Servo, 22, was found beaten and strangled in her Abilene, Texas apartment in September 2002, a few months after starting her first on-air job at KRBC-TV. No one has been charged.

name: Damon and Devon Routier
summary: Brothers Damon (5) and Devon (6) Routier were stabbed to death in their Texas home. Their mother Darlie Routier claimed an intruder attacked them but was convicted and sentenced to death.

name: Israel Keyes Victims
summary: Serial killer Israel Keyes murdered at least 3 people but is suspected of killing 11 or more across the US. He pre-planned murders using buried 'kill kits.' He died by suicide in jail.

name: Jennifer Pan
summary: Bich Ha Pan was shot dead and her husband Hann Pan badly wounded in a staged home invasion at their Markham, Ontario home on November 8, 2010.

name: Karla Brown
summary: Karla Brown, 22, was murdered in her Wood River, Illinois home in June 1978, shortly before her planned wedding. John Prante was convicted in 1983 largely on bite mark evidence and sentenced to 75 years.

name: Mary Day
summary: Thirteen-year-old Mary Louise Day disappeared from her home in Seaside, California, in July 1981, and investigators long suspected she had been killed.

name: Adea Shabani
summary: Aspiring actress Adea Shabani, 25, was last seen leaving her Hollywood apartment on February 23, 2018. Her remains were found a month later in a shallow grave in Nevada County in Northern California; she died of blunt force…

name: Ashley Ellerin
summary: Fashion student Ashley Ellerin was stabbed 47 times in her Hollywood home. Serial killer Michael Gargiulo, the 'Hollywood Ripper,' was convicted in 2019. Actor Ashton Kutcher testified at trial.

name: Brittney Wood
summary: Nineteen-year-old Brittney Wood vanished while on her way to meet her uncle in Mobile, Alabama. The investigation uncovered a massive family sexual abuse ring. Brittney has never been found.

name: Cieha Taylor
summary: Twenty-eight-year-old Cieha Taylor vanished on February 6, 2020, in Plant City, Florida. Hours after she was last seen, her car was found abandoned near railroad tracks with the engine running and her phone inside.

name: Girly Chew Hossencofft
summary: Girly Chew Hossencofft disappeared from Albuquerque in 1999 during a divorce from her husband Diazien, who claimed to be a government scientist with alien DNA.

name: Jessie Davis
summary: Nine-months-pregnant Jessie Davis vanished from her Ohio home. Her boyfriend, Canton police officer Bobby Cutts Jr., was convicted of her murder.

name: Sherin Mathews
summary: Three-year-old adopted Indian girl Sherin Mathews was reported missing in Richardson, Texas. Her adoptive father Wesley Mathews later admitted to killing her. He was sentenced to life.

name: Lina Sardar Khil
summary: Three-year-old Lina Sardar Khil, a daughter of Afghan refugees, vanished from a playground at a San Antonio apartment complex. Despite massive searches, she has never been found.

name: Sneha Anne Philip (9/11)
summary: Doctor Sneha Anne Philip vanished on September 10, 2001, the day before the 9/11 attacks. It remains unclear whether her disappearance is related to the attacks or a separate incident.

name: Yaser Said Victims
summary: Egyptian-born taxi driver Yaser Said murdered his daughters Amina (18) and Sarah (17) in an honor killing in Irving, Texas. He fled and was captured 12 years later.

name: Karlie Gusé
summary: Sixteen-year-old Karlie Gusé vanished from her family's home in rural Chalfant Valley, California after experiencing a bad reaction to marijuana. She was seen walking on the highway at dawn.

name: Katelin Akens
summary: Nineteen-year-old Katelin Akens disappeared on December 5, 2015, in the Spotsylvania, Virginia area while on her way to catch a flight home to Arizona; her luggage was found by a roadside two days later.

name: Flora Fire Victims
summary: Four sisters aged 5 to 11 died in an arson fire at their home in Flora, Indiana, on November 21, 2016. Their mother escaped with injuries. No one has been arrested and the Indiana State Police investigation remains open.

name: Claremont Serial Murders
summary: Three women vanished from the upscale suburb of Claremont in Perth, Australia between 1996-1997. Telstra technician Bradley Edwards was convicted of two murders in 2020.

name: Emanuela Zuccala
summary: Leonardo Cazzaniga, an emergency room doctor at Saronno Hospital in Lombardy, Italy, killed patients with lethal drug cocktails between 2010 and 2014. He was sentenced to life in prison in January 2020.

name: Michael & Alex Smith
summary: Susan Smith drowned her two sons Michael (3) and Alex (14 months) by rolling her car into John D. Long Lake. She initially claimed a Black carjacker took them.

name: Yates Children
summary: Andrea Yates drowned her five children in the bathtub during a severe psychotic episode. She was found not guilty by reason of insanity after an initial conviction was overturned.

name: Teresa Sievers
summary: Dr. Teresa Sievers was bludgeoned to death in her Bonita Springs, Florida home. Her husband Mark hired two friends to murder her. All three were convicted.

name: Tamla Horsford
summary: Tamla Horsford, a Black mother of five, was found dead at a sleepover party at a white friend's home in Cumming, Georgia. Her death was ruled accidental but her family disputes this.

name: Emma Walker
summary: Sixteen-year-old Emma Walker was shot through her bedroom wall by her obsessive ex-boyfriend William Riley Gaul while she slept. Gaul, a high school football player, was convicted.

name: Katelyn Markham
summary: Twenty-one-year-old Katelyn Markham vanished from her Fairfield, Ohio home in August 2011; her remains were found in 2013 in Cedar Grove, Indiana.

name: Tammy Daybell
summary: Tammy Daybell was murdered by her husband Chad Daybell, who wanted to marry Lori Vallow. Her death was initially ruled natural but later reclassified as homicide.

name: Maggie & Paul Murdaugh
summary: Maggie Murdaugh and her son Paul were shot dead at the family's Moselle hunting estate in Islandton, South Carolina, on June 7, 2021.

name: Sherri Papini
summary: Sherri Papini faked her own kidnapping in Redding, California, claiming two Hispanic women abducted her. She was found alive after 22 days. In 2022, she pleaded guilty to hoax charges.

name: Ana Walshe (Brian Walshe case)
summary: Ana Walshe, 39, vanished from her Cohasset, Massachusetts home on New Year's Day 2023; her body has never been found. Her husband Brian Walshe was convicted of first-degree murder on December 15, 2025 and sentenced to life in…

name: Harmony Montgomery
summary: Five-year-old Harmony Montgomery was last seen in Manchester, New Hampshire in December 2019 but was not reported missing until late 2021; her body has never been found.

name: Doerman Children
summary: Chad Doerman shot and killed his three young sons, aged 7, 4 and 3, at their home in Monroe Township, Clermont County, Ohio. He pleaded guilty in August 2024 and was sentenced to three consecutive life terms without parole.

name: Eric Richins
summary: Eric Richins, 39, died of a fentanyl overdose at his home in Kamas, Utah on March 4, 2022. His wife Kouri Richins, who later published a children's book about grief, was convicted of aggravated murder in March 2026 and sentenced…

name: Ruby Franke Children
summary: YouTube parenting vlogger Ruby Franke and therapist Jodi Hildebrandt were convicted of aggravated child abuse after Ruby's emaciated, bound son escaped to a neighbor's home.

name: Eliza Fletcher
summary: Teacher and heiress Eliza Fletcher was abducted while jogging near the University of Memphis and murdered. Cleotha Abston, who had a prior kidnapping conviction, was sentenced to life.

name: Gilgo Beach (additional victims)
summary: After his July 2023 arrest for three Gilgo Beach murders, Rex Heuermann was charged with four more killings in 2024. In April 2026 he pleaded guilty to seven murders and admitted an eighth, and on June 17, 2026 he was sentenced…

name: Vicky White & Casey White Escape
summary: Corrections officer Vicky White helped murder suspect Casey White escape from an Alabama jail. They were fugitives for 11 days before being caught in Indiana. Vicky died from a self-inflicted gunshot.

name: Bryan Kohberger (additional details)
summary: Criminology PhD student Bryan Kohberger pleaded guilty on July 2, 2025 to murdering four University of Idaho students in Moscow, Idaho on November 13, 2022.

name: Gabby Petito (foundation/legacy)
summary: After Gabby Petito's murder, her family established the Gabby Petito Foundation to support domestic violence awareness. New legislation was passed in her name.

name: Michelle Troconis
summary: Jennifer Dulos, 50, disappeared from New Canaan, Connecticut on May 24, 2019; her body has never been found and she was declared legally dead in 2023.

name: Shanann, Bella & Celeste Watts
summary: Chris Watts murdered his pregnant wife Shanann and their daughters Bella (4) and Celeste (3) in Frederick, Colorado. He disposed of their bodies at his work site. He was sentenced to life.

name: Orsolya Gaal
summary: Orsolya Gaal was stabbed nearly 60 times in her Queens home and her body was placed in a duffel bag. Her former handyman David Bonola pleaded guilty to manslaughter.

name: Sandy Hook Victims
summary: Adam Lanza shot and killed 20 children and 6 staff members at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut before killing himself. It remains one of the deadliest school shootings in U.S. history.

name: Parkland Shooting Victims
summary: Nikolas Cruz killed 17 people and wounded 17 others at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. He was sentenced to life without parole.

name: Mary Morris (wrong target)
summary: Mary Lou Morris, 48, was found dead in her burned car near Houston on October 12, 2000. Days later another Houston-area woman named Mary Morris was found shot dead in her car.

name: Tara Baker (Georgia)
summary: UGA law student Tara Baker, 23, was found murdered in her burning Athens, Georgia apartment on January 19, 2001. The case went cold for 23 years until a DNA match led to the May 2024 arrest of Edrick Faust, who was convicted on…

name: Tristan Brübach
summary: Thirteen-year-old Tristan Brübach was brutally murdered in an underground pedestrian passage in Frankfurt, Germany. The case remains one of Germany's most notorious unsolved child murders.

name: Maleah Davis
summary: Four-year-old Maleah Davis was reported missing in Houston in May 2019 by her mother's ex-fiance Derion Vence, who claimed she was abducted during a carjacking.

name: Tyler Hadley Victims
summary: Seventeen-year-old Tyler Hadley bludgeoned his parents to death with a hammer, hid their bodies in a bedroom, and then hosted a house party. He was sentenced to life.

name: Trudy Appleby
summary: Eleven-year-old Trudy Appleby vanished from Moline, Illinois on August 21, 1996; her body has never been found. In August 2025 a Henry County grand jury indicted Jamison Fisher, a long-named person of interest, on first-degree…

name: Bianca Devins
summary: Seventeen-year-old Bianca Devins was murdered by Brandon Clark, who then posted photos of her body on Instagram. The case highlighted issues of online violence and platform responsibility.

name: Rachel & Lillian Entwistle
summary: Neil Entwistle shot his wife Rachel and infant daughter Lillian before fleeing to England. He was extradited and convicted of double murder.

name: Savannah Spurlock
summary: Twenty-two-year-old Savannah Spurlock was last seen leaving a Lexington bar with three men. Her remains were found months later at the property of David Sparks, who pleaded guilty to murder.

name: Jennifer Pan (case)
summary: Bich Ha Pan, 53, was shot dead and her husband Hann was critically wounded in a staged home invasion at their Markham, Ontario home on November 8, 2010, arranged by their daughter Jennifer Pan.

name: Evelyn Boswell
summary: Fifteen-month-old Evelyn Boswell was reported missing in February 2020 but had actually been dead since December 2019. Her mother Megan Boswell was convicted of her murder.

name: Daniel Holtzclaw Victims
summary: Oklahoma City police officer Daniel Holtzclaw was accused by 13 Black women of rape and sexual assault while on duty between December 2013 and June 2014.

name: Lauren Smith-Fields
summary: Twenty-three-year-old Lauren Smith-Fields was found dead after a Bumble date in Bridgeport, Connecticut. Her family alleges police mishandled the investigation due to racial bias.

name: Shanquella Robinson
summary: Twenty-five-year-old Shanquella Robinson died on a group trip to Cabo San Lucas, Mexico. Video showed her being beaten by a friend. Her death was ruled homicide but no extradition has occurred.

name: Richard Allen (Delphi)
summary: Richard Allen was convicted in 2024 of the Delphi murders of Abby Williams and Libby German. He was identified five years after the crime despite being interviewed early in the investigation.

name: Richard Matt & David Sweat Prison Escape
summary: Convicted murderers Richard Matt and David Sweat escaped from Clinton Correctional Facility using power tools smuggled by a prison employee. Matt was killed and Sweat was recaptured after 23 days.

name: Hart Family
summary: Jennifer and Sarah Hart drove their SUV off a cliff in Mendocino County, California, killing themselves and their six adopted children. The murders followed a CPS visit.

name: Gloria Satterfield
summary: Murdaugh family housekeeper Gloria Satterfield died after a fall at the Murdaugh home. Alex Murdaugh collected $4.3 million in insurance but stole the money from her sons.

name: JJ Vallow & Tylee Ryan
summary: JJ Vallow (7) and Tylee Ryan (16) were murdered by their mother Lori Vallow and stepfather Chad Daybell, who held apocalyptic religious beliefs. Both children were buried on Chad's property.

name: Don Lewis
summary: Millionaire exotic animal owner Don Lewis vanished in Tampa, Florida on August 18, 1997 and was declared legally dead in 2002. The Netflix series 'Tiger King' revived interest in the case and aired accusations against his wife…

name: Mallory Beach
summary: Mallory Beach was killed when Paul Murdaugh crashed a boat while drunk in Beaufort County, South Carolina. Paul was charged with BUI resulting in death but was murdered before trial.

name: Somerton Man (identified)
summary: The Somerton Man, found dead on Somerton Park beach in Adelaide on December 1, 1948, was identified in July 2022 by researchers Derek Abbott and Colleen Fitzpatrick through DNA genealogy as Carl "Charles" Webb, a Melbourne-born…

name: Dena Dean
summary: Fifteen-year-old Dena Dean was found stabbed to death in a park in Tamworth, England on her way to school. Despite extensive investigation, her killer has never been identified.

name: Camp Gladiator Slaying (detail)
summary: The distinctive gait of the tactical-gear-clad suspect in the Missy Bevers murder has been extensively analyzed. The suspect's identity remains unknown despite clear surveillance footage.

name: Tupac Shakur (arrest)
summary: Duane 'Keffe D' Davis was arrested and indicted on September 29, 2023 for the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas, after describing his role in interviews and a 2019 memoir.

name: Jorge Torres Jr.
summary: Jorge Torres Jr. was found dead inside a suitcase in Winter Park, Florida. His girlfriend Sarah Boone claimed he died during a hide-and-seek game. She filmed him begging to be let out.

name: Carlee Russell Hoax
summary: Carlee Russell faked her own kidnapping in Hoover, Alabama, sparking a massive search. She returned home two days later. She had researched Amber Alerts and kidnapping beforehand.

name: RJR Maintenance Murders
summary: Four people were murdered at RJR Maintenance in Mandan, North Dakota. Chiropractor Chad Isaak, a tenant of the property management company, was convicted after his car was caught on surveillance.

name: Ahmaud Arbery (Glynn County detail)
summary: Former Glynn County District Attorney Jackie Johnson was indicted in September 2021, accused of showing favor to Greg McMichael, a retired investigator from her office, after the February 2020 killing of Ahmaud Arbery.

name: Lori Vallow Pre-Murder Timeline
summary: Before the murders of her children, Lori Vallow's fourth husband Charles was shot dead in Chandler, Arizona on July 11, 2019 by her brother Alex Cox, who claimed self-defense.

name: Bryan Kohberger Trial
summary: Bryan Kohberger's trial for the murders of four University of Idaho students was moved to Boise and set for August 2025, but it never took place.

name: Karen Read Trial
summary: Karen Read was charged with killing her boyfriend, Boston police officer John O'Keefe, by hitting him with her SUV in Canton, Massachusetts in January 2022; her defense alleged a cover-up.

name: Rex Heuermann
summary: Architect Rex Heuermann was arrested in July 2023 for the Gilgo Beach serial killings after DNA from a discarded pizza crust and digital evidence linked him to the victims.

name: Sandy Hook Defamation Cases
summary: Alex Jones was found liable for defaming Sandy Hook families by calling the massacre a hoax. Combined judgments exceeded $1.4 billion. The cases established precedent for conspiracy theory accountability.

name: Jordan Neely
summary: Jordan Neely, a 30-year-old homeless man experiencing a mental health crisis on a New York City subway train, died after being placed in a chokehold by fellow passenger Daniel Penny on May 1, 2023.

name: Daybell-Vallow Death Toll
summary: The Daybell-Vallow case involved five deaths connected to apocalyptic religious beliefs: Tammy Daybell, JJ Vallow, Tylee Ryan, Charles Vallow, and Alex Cox. Chad and Lori received death and life sentences.

name: Murdaugh Financial Crimes
summary: Alex Murdaugh stole roughly $8.7 million from clients, including vulnerable accident victims and the family of his late housekeeper Gloria Satterfield.

name: Daniel Brophy
summary: Chef Daniel Brophy was murdered at the Oregon Culinary Institute. His wife Nancy, a romance novelist who wrote an essay called 'How to Murder Your Husband,' was convicted of his murder.

name: Halyna Hutchins
summary: Cinematographer Halyna Hutchins was shot and killed by a prop gun fired by Alec Baldwin on the set of 'Rust.' Armorer Hannah Gutierrez-Reed was convicted of involuntary manslaughter.

name: Fotis Dulos (death)
summary: Fotis Dulos, charged with the murder of his wife Jennifer, attempted suicide by carbon monoxide poisoning in his garage while awaiting trial. He died two days later without ever standing trial.

name: Nikki Kuhnhausen
summary: Seventeen-year-old transgender girl Nikki Kuhnhausen was killed in June 2019 by David Bogdanov after he learned she was transgender. Her remains were found on Larch Mountain in Clark County six months later.

name: Dayton Shooting
summary: Connor Betts opened fire in the Oregon District of Dayton, Ohio, killing nine people including his sister. Police shot him dead within 32 seconds of the first shots.

name: Maleah Davis (CPS failure)
summary: Before her death in 2019, four-year-old Maleah Davis had been removed from her home by CPS after a skull fracture but was later returned.

name: Joel & Lisa Guy Sr.
summary: Joel Guy Jr. murdered his parents over Thanksgiving weekend and dismembered them, dissolving body parts in acid. He was motivated by wanting to keep receiving financial support from them.

name: Dylan Redwine (Mark Redwine trial)
summary: Thirteen-year-old Dylan Redwine was murdered during a court-ordered visit with his father Mark near Durango, Colorado. Mark was convicted in 2021 after Dylan's remains were found.

name: Gannon Stauch (Letecia trial)
summary: Letecia Stauch murdered her 11-year-old stepson Gannon in Colorado Springs in January 2020 and drove his body to Florida, where it was found under a bridge in March 2020.

name: Alex Cox
summary: Alex Cox, brother of Lori Vallow, died suddenly on December 12, 2019, five months after he shot and killed Charles Vallow. The medical examiner ruled the death natural, caused by blood clots in the lungs.

name: Suzanne Morphew (Barry trial)
summary: Suzanne Morphew vanished from her home near Salida, Colorado on Mother's Day 2020. Her husband Barry Morphew was charged with her murder in 2021, but the case was dismissed in April 2022; her remains were found in September 2023.

name: Stephen Smith
summary: Nineteen-year-old Stephen Smith was found dead on a rural Hampton County road in July 2015. His death was initially treated as a hit-and-run, though no vehicle debris was found.

name: Brian Laundrie (confession)
summary: Brian Laundrie's remains were found in Carlton Reserve, Florida with a notebook confession. He admitted to killing Gabby Petito and wrote that he thought he was 'ending her life mercifully.'

name: Moab Incident (Petito-Laundrie)
summary: Moab police responded to a domestic violence call involving Gabby Petito and Brian Laundrie but separated them for the night rather than making an arrest. An independent review found failures.

name: Russell Williams Victims
summary: Colonel Russell Williams, commander of Canada's largest airbase, was convicted of murdering two women after years of escalating crimes. His interrogation by Detective Sergeant Jim Smyth is studied worldwide.

name: Robert Pickton (conviction)
summary: Pig farmer Robert Pickton was convicted of six counts of second-degree murder at his Port Coquitlam farm. He was linked to 49 missing women. He was killed in prison in 2024.

name: Peter Nygard Victims
summary: Fashion mogul Peter Nygard was arrested for racketeering and sex trafficking charges involving dozens of women. He was convicted in Canadian courts of sexual assault.

name: Derrick Todd Lee Victims
summary: Derrick Todd Lee was the Baton Rouge serial killer who murdered at least seven women between 1992 and 2003. DNA evidence finally linked the crimes and led to his arrest.

name: Waneta Hoyt Children
summary: Waneta Hoyt murdered her five children between 1965 and 1971, presenting each death as SIDS. Her case was cited in medical literature supporting SIDS research before the truth emerged.

name: Yingying Zhang
summary: Chinese visiting scholar Yingying Zhang was kidnapped in Urbana, Illinois and murdered by former University of Illinois PhD student Brendt Christensen, who was sentenced to life without parole in 2019.

name: Jun Lin
summary: Luka Magnotta murdered Chinese international student Jun Lin in Montreal, dismembered him, and mailed body parts to political offices. He fled internationally before being caught in Berlin.

name: Nina Reiser (Hans trial)
summary: Linux programmer Hans Reiser murdered his wife Nina during a custody dispute. He led police to her body in the Oakland hills after being convicted, in exchange for a second-degree murder plea.

name: Stephen Port Victims
summary: Serial killer Stephen Port drugged and raped young men using GHB, killing four in Barking, East London. Police initially failed to link the deaths despite bodies being found in similar locations.

name: Yorkshire Ripper (death)
summary: Peter Sutcliffe, the Yorkshire Ripper who murdered 13 women in northern England, died of COVID-19 in prison in November 2020 after refusing treatment. He had served 39 years.

name: Sarah Everard (Wayne Couzens)
summary: Metropolitan Police officer Wayne Couzens kidnapped, raped, and murdered Sarah Everard while she walked home in London. He used his police credentials to make a false arrest. Sentenced to whole life.

name: Grace Millane
summary: British backpacker Grace Millane was murdered in Auckland, New Zealand on the eve of her 22nd birthday by Jesse Kempson, a man she met on Tinder.

name: Ivan Milat (Backpacker Murders)
summary: Ivan Milat was convicted of murdering seven backpackers whose bodies were found in Belanglo State Forest, NSW, Australia. He tortured and killed hitchhikers between 1989 and 1992.

name: Cleo Smith (rescue)
summary: Four-year-old Cleo Smith was taken from her family's tent at a campsite in Western Australia. After 18 days, police rescued her from a locked house in Carnarvon. Terence Kelly was convicted.

name: April Jones
summary: Five-year-old April Jones was abducted and murdered in Machynlleth, Wales by Mark Bridger. Only small bone fragments were ever recovered. Bridger was sentenced to whole life.

name: Jennifer Laude
summary: Transgender Filipina Jennifer Laude was murdered by U.S. Marine Joseph Scott Pemberton in a motel in Olongapo. The case strained U.S.-Philippine relations and sparked debate about the Visiting Forces Agreement.

name: Daniel Morcombe (solved)
summary: Thirteen-year-old Daniel Morcombe was abducted while waiting for a bus on Queensland's Sunshine Coast. His killer Brett Peter Cowan was caught through an elaborate undercover operation in 2011.

name: Otto Warmbier
summary: American student Otto Warmbier was detained in North Korea for 17 months and returned to the U.S. in a vegetative state. He died days later. North Korea claimed he contracted botulism.

name: Jamal Khashoggi
summary: Saudi journalist Jamal Khashoggi was killed and dismembered inside the Saudi consulate in Istanbul by a team of Saudi agents. Eight people were convicted in a closed Saudi trial. A declassified 2021 U.S.

name: Alexander Litvinenko
summary: Former Russian spy Alexander Litvinenko was poisoned with polonium-210 in London. A British inquiry concluded Russian President Putin probably approved the operation. Two suspects were identified.

name: Sergei & Yulia Skripal Poisoning
summary: Former Russian double agent Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia were poisoned with Novichok nerve agent in Salisbury, England, and both survived; Dawn Sturgess died in July 2018 after handling the discarded agent.

name: Junko Furuta
summary: Seventeen-year-old Junko Furuta was kidnapped and tortured for 40 days by four teenage boys before dying of her injuries in Tokyo. The extreme nature of the case shocked Japan.

name: Natascha Kampusch
summary: Ten-year-old Natascha Kampusch was kidnapped on her way to school in Vienna and held captive by Wolfgang Priklopil for over eight years in a basement dungeon. She escaped in 2006.

name: Peter & Joan Porco
summary: Chris Porco attacked his parents with an axe while they slept in Delmar, New York. His father died; his mother survived but lost an eye. Joan initially identified Chris by nodding, then denied it.

name: Gypsy Rose Blanchard (release)
summary: Gypsy Rose Blanchard was released from prison in December 2023 after serving 8 years for conspiring to murder her mother Dee Dee, who had subjected her to Munchausen syndrome by proxy abuse for decades.

name: Donnah Winger
summary: Mark Winger murdered his wife Donnah and a shuttle driver he lured to their home, staging it to look like a break-in. He was a hero until a friend went to police years later.

name: Rebecca Zahau (civil case)
summary: Rebecca Zahau, 32, was found hanging at the Spreckels mansion in Coronado in July 2011; the San Diego County Sheriff ruled her death a suicide and reaffirmed that finding after a 2018 review.

name: Betty Broderick (case detail)
summary: Betty Broderick shot her ex-husband Dan and his new wife Linda dead in their bed in San Diego in 1989. After one mistrial, she was convicted of two counts of second-degree murder and sentenced to 32 years to life.

name: Joe Andriano
summary: Wendi Andriano murdered her terminally ill husband Joe by poisoning him with sodium azide and then bludgeoning him. She claimed self-defense. She was sentenced to death.

name: Liam Fee
summary: Two-year-old Liam Fee was murdered by his mother Rachel and her partner Nyomi Fee in Glenrothes, Scotland. He had suffered prolonged abuse. They also abused two other children.

name: Daniel Pelka
summary: Four-year-old Daniel Pelka was starved and beaten to death by his mother and stepfather in Coventry, England. He had been so hungry he stole food from bins at school. Multiple agencies failed to protect him.

name: Suzy Lamplugh (suspect)
summary: Estate agent Suzy Lamplugh vanished after leaving to meet a client named 'Mr. Kipper' in London in 1986; she was declared dead in absentia and her body has never been found.

name: Marc Dutroux Victims
summary: Marc Dutroux kidnapped six girls in Belgium, killing four. Two were rescued alive from a dungeon. The case exposed police incompetence and triggered massive protests, reshaping Belgian politics.

name: Josef Fritzl Case
summary: Josef Fritzl imprisoned his daughter Elisabeth in a cellar for 24 years, fathering seven children with her. The case was discovered in 2008 when one of the children needed hospital care.

name: Amanda Knox (case)
summary: American student Amanda Knox was convicted, then acquitted, then reconvicted, then definitively acquitted of the murder of her roommate Meredith Kercher in Perugia, Italy. Rudy Guede was convicted.

name: Reeva Steenkamp
summary: Paralympic champion Oscar Pistorius shot and killed his girlfriend Reeva Steenkamp through a locked bathroom door on Valentine's Day. He claimed he thought she was an intruder. He was convicted of murder.

name: Amy Schulz (Schuerr)
summary: Amy Schulz Schuerr was found dead in her Peru, Indiana home in September 2019 in a scene initially reported as a fall. Her husband Benjamin Schuerr was later convicted of murder after forensic evidence and witness testimony…

name: Brittney Griner (detention)
summary: WNBA star Brittney Griner was detained in Russia for carrying cannabis cartridges. She was convicted and sentenced to 9 years but freed in a prisoner exchange for arms dealer Viktor Bout.

name: Madeline Soto
summary: Thirteen-year-old Madeline Soto was killed in Kissimmee, Florida, in February 2024 by her mother's boyfriend, Stephan Sterns, who had sexually abused her for years.

name: Laken Riley
summary: Twenty-two-year-old Augusta University nursing student Laken Riley was murdered while jogging on the University of Georgia campus in Athens. Jose Ibarra, a Venezuelan national in the U.S.

name: Rachel Morin
summary: Mother of five Rachel Morin was murdered while hiking on the Ma & Pa Heritage Trail in Bel Air, Maryland. Victor Martinez-Hernandez, a Salvadoran national, was arrested in Oklahoma in June 2024, convicted in April 2025 of…

name: Audrii Cunningham
summary: Eleven-year-old Audrii Cunningham was murdered by Don Steven McDougal, a family friend who was supposed to take her to the school bus. Her body was found in the Trinity River.

name: Ruby Garcia
summary: Twenty-five-year-old Ruby Garcia was shot and killed and left beside US-131 in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Brandon Ortiz-Vite, her ex-boyfriend and a Mexican national who was in the U.S.

name: Elijah Vue
summary: Three-year-old Elijah Vue was reported missing from Two Rivers, Wisconsin, on February 20, 2024, and his remains were found in a wooded area in September 2024.

name: King Von
summary: Chicago rapper King Von (Dayvon Bennett) was shot and killed outside an Atlanta nightclub during a shootout between rival groups.

name: XXXTentacion
summary: Rapper XXXTentacion (Jahseh Onfroy) was shot and killed during a robbery outside a motorcycle dealership in Deerfield Beach, Florida.

name: Pop Smoke
summary: Brooklyn rapper Pop Smoke (Bashar Jackson) was shot and killed during a home invasion in Hollywood Hills. Several teenagers admitted their roles, most of them in juvenile court, and the only adult defendant, Corey Walker, was…

name: Young Dolph
summary: Memphis rapper Young Dolph (Adolph Thornton Jr.) was shot and killed while buying cookies at Makeda's Homemade Cookies. Justin Johnson was convicted of first-degree murder in September 2024 and sentenced to life; Cornelius…

name: Paul Bernardo & Karla Homolka Victims
summary: Paul Bernardo and Karla Homolka, the 'Ken and Barbie Killers,' raped and murdered teenagers Leslie Mahaffy and Kristen French in Ontario. Homolka received a controversial plea deal.

name: Clifford Olson Victims
summary: Canadian serial killer Clifford Olson murdered 11 children in British Columbia. He received a controversial $100,000 payment in exchange for revealing the location of victims' bodies.

name: Annecy Knife Attack
summary: A man stabbed six people, including four toddlers, at a lakeside playground in Annecy, France, in June 2023. All survived. The suspect, Abdalmasih Hanoun, a Syrian refugee who had been living in Sweden, was charged with…

name: Night Stalker (Richard Ramirez)
summary: Richard Ramirez terrorized Los Angeles in 1984-1985, breaking into homes and committing murder, rape, and robbery. He was caught by an angry mob and convicted of 13 murders.

name: Pedro López (Monster of the Andes)
summary: Pedro López confessed to killing over 300 girls across Colombia, Ecuador, and Peru. Released in 1998, his whereabouts are unknown. He is considered one of history's most prolific serial killers.

name: Tsutomu Miyazaki Victims
summary: Tsutomu Miyazaki, the 'Otaku Killer,' murdered four young girls in the Tokyo/Saitama area. He kept body parts as trophies and sent taunting letters to families. He was executed in 2008.

name: Elisa Lam (Cecil Hotel detail)
summary: The bizarre elevator surveillance video of Elisa Lam at the Cecil Hotel went viral. Her body was found in a rooftop water tank. Her death was ruled accidental drowning related to bipolar disorder.

name: Golden State Killer (arrest)
summary: Joseph James DeAngelo, the Golden State Killer, was arrested in 2018 through investigative genetic genealogy. The former police officer had committed 13 murders and 50+ rapes across California.

name: Casey White (murder conviction)
summary: Connie Ridgeway, 59, was found stabbed to death in her Lauderdale County, Alabama apartment in October 2015. Inmate Casey White confessed in 2020 and was charged with capital murder, but he later recanted and pleaded not guilty…

name: Alex Batty (found)
summary: British teenager Alex Batty was found in the French Pyrenees after being missing for six years. His mother and grandfather had taken him to Morocco and then a hippie commune in France.

name: Baby Holly (found alive)
summary: Holly Marie Clouse was found alive at age 42 in Oklahoma after her parents were identified as murdered Jane and John Does from 1981. She had been handed to a church by two women in robes.

name: Nicola Bulley
summary: Nicola Bulley vanished while walking her dog by the River Wyre in Lancashire, England. Her body was found in the river three weeks later. The case drew massive attention and amateur sleuthing.

name: Holly Wells & Jessica Chapman
summary: Ten-year-olds Holly Wells and Jessica Chapman were murdered by school caretaker Ian Huntley in Soham, Cambridgeshire, in August 2002.

name: Moors Murders Victims
summary: Ian Brady and Myra Hindley murdered five children in Manchester, England, burying some on Saddleworth Moor. Keith Bennett's body has never been found. The case remains one of Britain's most notorious.

name: Fred & Rose West Victims
summary: Fred and Rose West murdered at least 12 young women at their home at 25 Cromwell Street, Gloucester. Victims were buried in the garden and cellar. Fred hanged himself before trial; Rose was convicted.

name: Peter Tobin Victims
summary: Serial killer Peter Tobin murdered at least three young women. Bodies of two early victims were found under his former home 17 years after they disappeared. Tobin died in prison in 2022.

name: Josef Mengele (fugitive)
summary: Nazi doctor Josef Mengele, the 'Angel of Death' of Auschwitz, evaded capture for 34 years. He drowned while swimming in Brazil in 1979. His remains were identified by forensic examination in 1985.

name: Andrei Chikatilo Victims
summary: Soviet serial killer Andrei Chikatilo, the 'Butcher of Rostov,' murdered 52 women and children over 12 years. He was caught, convicted of 52 murders, and executed in 1994.

name: Aileen Wuornos (execution)
summary: Aileen Wuornos, who killed seven men along Florida highways, was executed in 2002. She had abandoned her appeals, saying she wanted to die. The case explored how childhood trauma can create killers.

name: Gilberto Valle (Cannibal Cop)
summary: NYPD officer Gilberto Valle was arrested in 2012 over online chats about kidnapping, cooking and eating women and was convicted by a jury in March 2013 of conspiracy to kidnap.

name: Diane Downs Children
summary: Diane Downs shot her three children in her car near Springfield, Oregon, killing one. She claimed a bushy-haired stranger carjacked them. She was convicted of murder and attempted murder.

name: JonBenét Ramsey (DNA testing)
summary: In 2024, Colorado authorities approved advanced DNA testing in the JonBenét Ramsey case using new forensic technology. The testing of touch DNA evidence could potentially identify the unknown male profile.

name: Marc Fogel
summary: American teacher Marc Fogel was arrested at a Moscow airport in August 2021 with about 17 grams of medical marijuana and sentenced in June 2022 to 14 years in a Russian penal colony.

name: Evan Gershkovich
summary: Wall Street Journal reporter Evan Gershkovich was arrested in Russia on espionage charges in March 2023, which he, his employer and the U.S. government denied.

name: Natalee Holloway (confession)
summary: Joran van der Sloot was extradited from Peru in June 2023 and on October 18, 2023, pleaded guilty in federal court in Alabama to extortion and wire fraud against Natalee Holloway's mother.

name: David Carrick Victims
summary: Metropolitan Police officer David Carrick pleaded guilty to 49 charges including 24 counts of rape against 12 women over 17 years and was given 36 life sentences with a minimum term of just over 30 years in February 2023.

name: John O'Keefe (Karen Read)
summary: Boston police officer John O'Keefe, 46, was found dead in the snow outside a home in Canton, Massachusetts, on January 29, 2022.

name: Riley Strain
summary: University of Missouri senior Riley Strain disappeared on Nashville's Broadway after being kicked out of a bar. His body was found in the Cumberland River two weeks later. His death was ruled accidental drowning.

name: Chad Daybell
summary: Chad Daybell was convicted of murdering his first wife Tammy, his new wife Lori Vallow's two children (JJ and Tylee), and conspiracy. He was sentenced to death.

name: Gilgo Beach (Rex Heuermann)
summary: Rex Heuermann, a New York City architect from Massapequa Park, was arrested in July 2023 and ultimately charged with the murders of seven women whose remains were found on Long Island.

name: Gabby Petito (domestic violence context)
summary: The Gabby Petito case highlighted systemic failures in law enforcement response to domestic violence. A Moab, Utah police stop weeks before her murder failed to recognize her as a DV victim.

name: Constance Marten & Mark Gordon
summary: Constance Marten and Mark Gordon went on the run across England after their newborn baby died. The baby's body was found in a bag in Brighton. Both were convicted of manslaughter by gross negligence.

name: Lucy Letby Victims
summary: Neonatal nurse Lucy Letby was convicted of murdering seven babies and attempting to murder six others at the Countess of Chester Hospital. She received a whole-life order.

name: Ivan Milat Victims (Backpacker Murders)
summary: Ivan Milat murdered seven backpackers in the Belanglo State Forest south of Sydney. Their bodies were found in 1992-1993. Milat was convicted in 1996 and died in prison in 2019.

name: Joanna Dennehy Victims
summary: Joanna Dennehy murdered three men in Peterborough and stabbed two others in Hereford in March and April 2013. In 2014 she became the third woman in the UK to receive a whole-life order, after Myra Hindley and Rose West.

name: Natalie McNally
summary: Natalie McNally, 32, who was 15 weeks pregnant, was stabbed to death in her home in Lurgan, Northern Ireland, on December 18, 2022.

name: Brianna Ghey
summary: Sixteen-year-old transgender girl Brianna Ghey was murdered in a park in Warrington by two 15-year-olds. The killers had planned the attack for weeks. Both received life sentences.

name: Jaylen Fleer
summary: San Diego County sheriff's deputy Jaylen Fleer, 27, was arrested in 2020 after Crime Stoppers tips about a man engaging in sex acts with a minor led investigators to him and to four underage victims.

name: Sherri Papini (hoax)
summary: Sherri Papini was convicted of faking her own kidnapping in 2016. She had claimed she was abducted while jogging and tortured by two Hispanic women. She had actually been staying with an ex-boyfriend.

name: Scott Peterson (new evidence)
summary: The Los Angeles Innocence Project took on Scott Peterson's case in early 2024, arguing that new evidence could show he did not murder his wife Laci.

name: Robert Hanssen (spy)
summary: FBI agent Robert Hanssen was arrested for spying for Russia for 22 years. He is considered the most damaging spy in FBI history, compromising dozens of agents. He died in prison in 2023.

name: Aldrich Ames (spy)
summary: CIA officer Aldrich Ames spied for the Soviet Union and Russia for nine years, compromising more than 100 intelligence operations. At least 10 agents he betrayed were executed.

name: Whitey Bulger (death)
summary: Notorious Boston mob boss and longtime FBI informant Whitey Bulger, 89, was beaten to death hours after arriving at USP Hazelton in West Virginia on October 30, 2018.

name: East Area Rapist Victims
summary: Before becoming the Golden State Killer, Joseph James DeAngelo committed at least 50 rapes in the Sacramento area as the East Area Rapist. He terrorized neighborhoods from 1976 to 1979.

name: Pamela Smart (case)
summary: Gregg Smart, 24, was shot dead in his Derry, New Hampshire condominium on May 1, 1990 by teenagers recruited by his wife Pamela's student lover, Billy Flynn.

name: Richard Glossip (case)

name: Bonny Lee Bakley (Robert Blake)
summary: Actor Robert Blake's wife Bonny Lee Bakley was shot dead outside a restaurant. Blake was acquitted of murder but found liable in a civil trial. The case officially remains unsolved.

name: Halyna Hutchins (Rust trial)
summary: Cinematographer Halyna Hutchins, 42, was fatally shot on the set of the film Rust near Santa Fe on October 21, 2021 when a revolver held by actor Alec Baldwin discharged a live round.

name: Barry Morphew (arrest detail)

summary: Theranos founder Elizabeth Holmes was convicted on January 3, 2022 of three counts of wire fraud and one count of conspiracy for deceiving investors about her blood-testing technology; she was acquitted of the counts involving…

name: Sandy Hook Defamation Judgment
summary: Alex Jones was ordered to pay nearly $1.5 billion in damages to Sandy Hook families for spreading conspiracy theories that the 2012 school shooting was a hoax.

name: Jeffrey Epstein (documents)
summary: In January 2024, court documents naming over 150 associates of Jeffrey Epstein were unsealed. The documents came from Virginia Giuffre's civil lawsuit against Ghislaine Maxwell.

name: George Santos (fraud)
summary: Former congressman George Santos, who had fabricated much of his biography, pleaded guilty on August 19, 2024 to wire fraud and aggravated identity theft in a scheme that defrauded campaign donors.

name: Sam Bankman-Fried (FTX)
summary: FTX founder Sam Bankman-Fried was convicted on November 2, 2023 of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy over the misuse of about $8 billion in customer funds at his crypto exchange, which collapsed in November 2022.

name: R. Kelly (sentencing)
summary: R&B singer R. Kelly was convicted in New York in September 2021 of racketeering and Mann Act sex trafficking offences and sentenced on June 29, 2022 to 30 years in prison.

name: Tyre Nichols
summary: Tyre Nichols, 29, died on January 10, 2023, three days after being beaten by Memphis police officers following a traffic stop. Former officers Desmond Mills Jr. and Emmitt Martin III pleaded guilty to federal and state charges.
